8260767.en: You can't imagine how heartbroken I'd have been in that situation.
8260767.ch: 那种情况别提心里有多苦了。

8260768.en: No, it's not that. I think sometimes I just want you by my side. That's enough for me. After all, we're looking for a needle in a haystack. If we succeed, that's great. If we don't, well, isn't that to be expected?
8260768.ch: 没有，不过我觉得有时候我可能只是希望你陪着我。这样就很好。本来就是大海捞针，如果成事当然是好，如果不成，那不也很正常嘛？

8260769.en: Just taking in the scenery and chatting with you makes me happy too.
8260769.ch: 看看风景，跟你说说话，也很开心。

8260770.en: Ao Yao giggles and pats your shoulder as if she's the one comforting you. But suddenly, two streams of blood start flowing from her nose.
8260770.ch: 敖瑶嘻嘻哈哈的拍着你肩膀，似乎反过来安慰你一样。然则就在此时她鼻子又留下两行长长的血水。

8260771.en: Ouch, looks like my old problem's flaring up again. Let's call it a day and come back another time. Otherwise, you'll end up carrying me home later.
8260771.ch: 哎呦，老毛病又犯了。咱们改天再来吧。不然待会又要你把我送回去了。

8260772.en: But Ao Yao suddenly doubles over with her words. Blood gushes out from her mouth, staining a large area in front of her a deep crimson. The sight is truly horrifying...
8260772.ch: 敖瑶正说着，突然间腰身一弯，小嘴一张，鲜血立即喷了出来，将身前大片地方染成一片殷红，观之惊心……

8260773.en: Fine... Let's call it a day. I'm heading back.
8260773.ch: 唉……今儿先这样吧，我回了。

8260774.en: Ao Yao wipes the blood from her mouth. She gives you a smile, then turns and walks away on her own.
8260774.ch: 敖瑶用手擦了擦嘴边的鲜血，对你笑了笑便抬步自己离开了。

8260775.en: Ao Yao stands by a small pond, lost in thought as she gazes into its crystal-clear surface. Hearing footsteps, she turns to look at you.
8260775.ch: 敖瑶正在小池边上看着里面清澈见底的水正在发呆，她听得人声，便朝你看了过来。

8260777.en: Mm, I suppose so. Coming here was my own doing—utilizing the power from the River Chart before I fully understood it. I brought this trouble upon myself.
8260777.ch: 嗯，好像是。来到八荒是我擅自使用尚未揣摩透的河图之力，是我闯下的祸。

8260778.en: With your help, I've finally found a way to return. It's truly a blessing from the heavens.
8260778.ch: 好不容易在你的帮助下，找到了回去的方法。真是侥天之幸呢。

8260779.en: I shouldn't dare to hope for anything more.
8260779.ch: 我不该再有什么奢望的。

8260781.en: Finally getting rid of this nuisance, right?
8260781.ch: 终于送走这个烦人的瘟神了，是吧？

8260782.en: Looks like you can't wait for me to leave right this second.
8260782.ch: 看来你巴不得我现在就走啊。

8260783.en: Spacing out? Not at all. I was pondering important matters.
8260783.ch: 发呆？我可是想着正事呢。

8260784.en: I was thinking... dying here wouldn't be so bad, really. We'll always have regrets in life anyway.
8260784.ch: 我在想，死在八荒其实也没什么啊。遗憾总是有的。

8260785.en: I'll meet you when I'm ready, okay? Let's search for a mystic realm together, one last time.
8260785.ch: 我准备好了找你，好不好？就当最后一次一起找秘境。

8260786.en: Hehe! Just wait, I'll definitely come meet you!
8260786.ch: 嘻嘻！你等着，我一定会找你的！

8260787.en: That's right. I'll be a real loser if I don't show up!

8260788.en: How can you be so heartless! Fine, I won't give you the satisfaction! Hmph!
8260788.ch: 你怎么这么绝情！我偏不让你如愿！哼！

8260789.en: Ao Yao giggles and smiles at you, but as she does, her eyes fill with tears. She hurriedly turns her head away.
8260789.ch: 敖瑶嘻嘻的对你笑着，但笑着笑着，眼中已全是泪光，她立即转过了头。

8260790.en: You should go now! I won't bother you for a while! But I'll come find you later! When I do, you'd better show up.
8260790.ch: 你先走吧！最近就先不打扰你了！我会找你的！到时候一定要来。

8260791.en: Ao Yao remains silent, her head turned away, refusing to look at you. At that moment, a single droplet falls from her face, hitting the water below and sending ripples across the surface...
8260791.ch: 敖瑶闷着声不发一言，她偏着头始终不去看你。就在此时，一滴水珠从她身前落下，滴到水中荡开一圈涟漪……

8260792.en: Hey, come on! Let's go on an adventure! It's the last time, I promise I won't bother you after this! Hehe! I'll be waiting for you!
8260792.ch: 喂，快来，我们去探险！最后一次了，保证以后不烦你！嘿嘿！我等你噢！

8260793.en: Ao Yao waves at you, her face beaming with joy. She then turns to leave, gesturing for you to hurry up and follow.
8260793.ch: 敖瑶笑意盎然朝你挥了挥手，然后转身离开，似乎是在示意你赶快跟上。

8260794.en: Oh, come on! At such a crucial moment, why is your face still so expressionless? I can't tell if you're happy or not!
8260794.ch: 哎呀，这么关键的时刻，为什么你的脸还是平平淡淡的看不出来是开心还是不开心？

8260795.en: Fine, it's not that important anyway!

8260796.en: Pah! You're happy I'm leaving, aren't you? You jerk!
8260796.ch: 呸！我要走了你很开心是吧！你这家伙！

8260797.en: Oh? Who knows if that's true or not? I'll just pretend you mean it!
8260797.ch: 哦？也不知道是真是假，权当你说的是真的吧！

8260798.en: Hey, you'll get over it soon! You hear me? Hehe! You really can't bear to see me go, can you? But who can blame you? I, the Dragon Princess, am a rare beauty, after all!
8260798.ch: 但是，难过一会就好了！知道吗？嘿嘿！你果然是舍不得我的，谁叫本公主貌美如花呢？

8260799.en: As Ao Yao giggles, the star patterns on her fair wrists suddenly emit a golden glow. She waves a hand and opens up a rift, just large enough for a person to pass through. A subtle force emanates from within as if it is trying to draw something in.
8260799.ch: 敖瑶嘻嘻哈哈的说着，突然间她皓腕上星纹发出金光，一条空间裂隙登慢慢张开。里面散发丝丝吸力，似乎要将什么吸纳进去一样。

8260800.en: I'm off then. Well, I just realized a thing. You have made friends with the Princess of the Dragon Palace in the East Sea! That's something you can brag about for the rest of your life!
8260800.ch: 我走啦。哈哈，我突然才想到，你作为东海龙宫公主的朋友，这事你可以吹一辈子了！

8260801.en: Ao Yao turns toward the rift as she speaks. With her back to you, she waves her hand. A gesture of farewell.
8260801.ch: 敖瑶说着转过头去，看着面前的裂隙，然后背朝你挥了挥手，似在道别。

8260803.en: Enough... Stop calling out! Don't! I don't want to make this any more awkward... Sure, I can be willful, but I'm a royal princess... I have to maintain some dignity, you know.
8260803.ch: 罢了……你还是别喊了！别！我不想把场面搞得那么难看……虽然我比较任性，但我可是堂堂龙宫公主……威仪庄重还是要的。

8260804.en: Suddenly, Ao Yao turns around. Tears well up in her eyes, glistening but never falling—a clear sign of her desperate struggle to maintain composure.
8260804.ch: 敖瑶突然转过身来，双眼泪水在眼眶中转啊转的，却始终没有落下，可见她在竭力忍耐。

8260805.en: I don't want to leave! Whether I live or die, I want to stay here!
8260805.ch: 我不想走，生也罢，死也罢，我想留在这里！

8260806.en: Every day, I force myself to laugh and smile, but it's all fake! I just didn't want to bring you down with me!
8260806.ch: 我每天都让自己开开心心的笑，那都是假的，我只是不想让你也一起变得不快！

8260807.en: I've tried desperately to stay, I truly gave it my all... I can't bear to leave... can't bear to leave you...
8260807.ch: 我拼了命想留下，我真的拼了命的……我舍不得……舍不得你……

8260808.en: With these words, tears begin to stream down Ao Yao's face in an uncontrollable flood...
8260808.ch: 敖瑶说着泪水哗啦啦的就落下了……

8260810.en: Ao Yao suddenly lunges toward you. But at that moment, the star patterns on her arms flare with golden light. She seems caught by an invisible force from the rift behind her and is unable to move another inch forward...
8260810.ch: 敖瑶说着突然迈开步子便朝你扑来，但同时手臂上的星纹金光大盛，她似乎被身后裂隙的吸力扯住，已无法再作寸进……

8260811.en: Wait for me! I swear I'll find a way to come back! Fifty years! Wait for me, I promise I'll find a way to return here!
8260811.ch: 你等我！我一定会设法回来的！二十年！不，十年，你等我，我一定会找到方法重新回到八荒的！

8260812.en: Ao Yao's tears are drawn into the rift before they can even fall. She struggles desperately against the pull, but finally collapses from exhaustion and is taken away. After Ao Yao vanishes into the rift, its radiant glow begins to fade. Finally, the rift closes, and the world around falls into an eerie silence as if nothing had ever happened...
8260812.ch: 敖瑶滴落的泪水未及落下，便被后方裂隙吸走。她竭力挣扎想要摆脱身后吸力，但最终却力尽跌倒，被吸力一举牵走。那道裂缝将敖瑶吸走以后，光芒由盛而衰，最后缝隙弥合，归于沉寂……

8260813.en: Ao Yao turns her back and spreads her arms, allowing the rift to draw her in. Her shoulders tremble as she lowers her head. Just as you try to get a closer look, she vanishes into the rift, gone in an instant.
8260813.ch: 敖瑶背过身去，舒张双手，任由裂隙吸力将她往前牵扯。她低着头肩膀微微抽动，你正想看仔细了，然而下一刻，她已没入裂隙之中消失不见。

8260814.en: You jerk! How can you be so cold-hearted?! You really won't say even a single word?!
8260814.ch: 你这混蛋，真能狠下心来！真的不说一句话！

8260820.en: You return to Ao Yao's dwelling. The inner chamber has been meticulously cleaned, with every object neatly arranged in its place.
8260820.ch: 你回到敖瑶的住处，只见内室已经好好的整理过了，周围的物件整整齐齐的。

8260821.en: When I left, I didn't know why I felt compelled to clean everything in the room so thoroughly.
8260821.ch: 离开的时候，我也不知道为什么还要把这屋内的东西打扫得干干净净。

8260822.en: Perhaps I just wanted it to be spotless when I arrived and equally pristine when I left.
8260822.ch: 可能只是想来的时候要干干净净，走的时候也必须干干净净。

8260823.en: Maybe I just couldn't bear to leave. Perhaps, deep down, I still cling to the hope that one day I might return to this place...
8260823.ch: 可能只是有点不舍得。可能，我心底还奢望有朝一日还能回到八荒，回到这里……

8260824.en: I know it's impossible. Returning to my own plane was already incredibly difficult, and miracles don't happen twice. It can't happen again...
8260824.ch: 我知道那是不可能的。我回归自己位面已经万分艰难，而奇迹也降临了一次，他不可能再降临一次……

8260825.en: I tell myself, let it be. As my father, the king of our clan, always said, we may strive every moment of our lives, but we can't grasp everything.
8260825.ch: 我跟自己说，罢了罢了。正如父王所说，我们虽然每时每刻都在争，但我们没办法把握每一样东西。

8260826.en: Just as I can't grasp the chance to return. I suppose this is what they call destiny? How can I possibly contend with the will of heaven itself?
8260826.ch: 正如我把握不了回来的机会。这就是所谓天命吧？难道我还能跟天争个什么吗？

8260827.en: I've managed to save my own life—I shouldn't push my luck any further. Heaven has been kind enough to me already.
8260827.ch: 我已经保住了自己性命，得了便宜就不要再卖乖了。上苍对我够眷顾的了。

8260828.en: The only thing I regret is that I never got to give you all those items I collected.
8260828.ch: 唯一让我感觉有点遗憾的是，那些收集起来的东西我最后都没能给到你。

8260829.en: These items, I collected them every time we explored the mystic realms together. I was saving them to give you when you needed them most.
8260829.ch: 这些东西，都是我每次和你查探秘境时收集的，我希望在你最需要的时候再给到你。

8260830.en: I know you always need these treasures. But having everything at your fingertips would only make you take them for granted. I didn't want that to happen.
8260830.ch: 我知道你无时无刻都需要这些宝物。但予取予求只会让你变得不珍惜，我不希望这样。

8260831.en: I didn't want you to take the things I gave you for granted... I didn't want you to take me for granted...
8260831.ch: 不希望你不珍惜我送给你的东西，不希望你不珍惜我……

8260832.en: I never thought this dilemma would trouble me right up until the moment I left...
8260832.ch: 没想到我会一直犹豫，犹豫到现在……

8260833.en: But I suppose it doesn't matter anymore. You might as well take all those things now.
8260833.ch: 不过现在已经没有意义了啊。那些东西你都拿走吧。

8260834.en: I truly regret not being able to give them to you in person.
8260834.ch: 真的很遗憾，没能亲手给到你。

8260835.en: I told myself that regrets were inevitable, but now I feel like I'm being overly dramatic about it.
8260835.ch: 我原本想着，遗憾是必然的，但这也太矫情了。

8260836.en: The fact that I couldn't give them to you personally... well, I brought that upon myself.
8260836.ch: 因为没能将礼物亲手给你，是我自己亲手造就的。

8260837.en: Lastly, I'm truly grateful for your companionship during my time in this world.
8260837.ch: 最后，在八荒这段日子，真的很感激你一直陪着我。

8260839.en: In the distance, lightning dances across the sky, cleaving the canopy. Amid the thunderous roar, countless lightning bolts converge, tearing open a rift in the void.
8260839.ch: 远方雷行电闪，割裂长空。轰鸣声中，万道电光纵横积攒，猛地在虚空中撕开一道裂缝。

8260840.en: You arrive at the site of the spatial rift. The surrounding area is in chaos—trees toppled, soil cracked, and withered grass scattered everywhere. Yet as you look around, there's not a soul in sight. Turning your gaze back to the rift, you see it slowly closing, sealing itself shut.
8260840.ch: 你来到那空间裂隙之处，周围大树倾倒，地壳皲裂，衰草乱飞，一片狼藉。然而四顾当下，却无人迹。你再看向那裂隙，已然慢慢弥合。

8260841.en: Suddenly, a cry echoes from afar, its power shaking the land. Meanwhile, a billow of cyan smoke surges upward, streaking toward the south.
8260841.ch: 此时远方传来一声龙吟，放眼看去，一股青气腾升高空，往南方而去。

8260843.en: You arrive at the source of the cry, but as you scan the surroundings, there's not a soul in sight...
8260843.ch: 你来到震鸣之处，然则放眼周遭，渺无人迹……

8260844.en: Just as you're about to leave, a monster suddenly emerges from the shadows, lunging toward you.
8260844.ch: 正当你打算离开之际，一只妖兽从暗中突出，向你猛扑而来。

8260845.en: The monster seems to be under the influence of some mysterious spell, and its moves are powerless. You defeat it and see the creature fleeing in a pathetic state.
8260845.ch: 那妖兽似乎曾受到龙族特殊术法钳制，你将之击败后，它便狼狈逃去。彼时周围残存特殊灵力，仿佛昔日敖瑶身上龙息。难道她已经回到八荒了？她回到八荒会去哪呢？是昔日故居吗？

8260846.en: The dwelling of your old friend has clearly been neglected for some time. Sunlight streams in, revealing dust motes dancing in the air. Cobwebs blanket the surroundings, and a faint scent of wood lingers in the air.
8260846.ch: 故人住处久未打理，日光中可见内室尘埃浮动，周围满布蛛网，还微闻一股木糠之气。

8260847.en: Suddenly, a flash of cyan catches your eye. As you turn, you see a tall, elegant woman looking back at you. Her expression shifts rapidly—from startled, to surprised, and finally to one of delighted recognition.
8260847.ch: 突然间一抹青影掠过，回头看去，只见一名身材高挑丽人也正朝你看来。她微一愕然，随即眼中透出惊喜。

8260849.en: Ao Yao gently leads you into the inner chamber, guiding you to a seat. She sits down across from you, her eyes crinkling with a warm smile as she looks you over.
8260849.ch: 敖瑶轻轻来到内室，将你拉到座位上，她也坐到你对面，笑眯眯的打量着你。

8260850.en: It seems you haven't changed a bit, have you?

8260851.en: Tee-hee! Why do I feel like there's more to that statement?
8260851.ch: 噗呲，怎么听起来话里有话？

8260852.en: Oh my, I'm glad you say that. I've always felt I should be constantly improving myself. That way, I might become worthy of even better company, you know?
8260852.ch: 哈哈，我还以为自己只是变成熟了。原来不止如此，还变得更漂亮了。

8260853.en: Heh! Is that any way to greet someone? I'll have you know I'm considered quite the beauty where I come from!
8260853.ch: 呸！见面却不说好话！我好歹也是我那边顶尖儿的美人儿呢！

8260854.en: Actually... I haven't really changed either. It's just that, appearance-wise, I might have aged a little.
8260854.ch: 其实……我也没变。就是样子，可能跟以前相比，老了一些。

8260855.en: It took quite some effort to get here. But in the end, I managed to return to this world. All those little trials and tribulations along the way? Not even worth mentioning.
8260855.ch: 一路走来，费了好些功夫呢。所幸最后还是成功回到八荒了。那些都是芝麻绿豆的事儿，不说也罢。

8260856.en: Indeed. After returning to my home world, I traveled to many places. There were tough times, sure, but with my restless nature, I wouldn't call it hardship. It's just who I am.
8260856.ch: 是呢，回家以后走过很多地方，有时会觉得苦，但我本来就是个停不下来的性子，倒也不算辛酸。

8260857.en: Let me tell you, in these past decades, I've opened more mystic realms than I've had hot meals. I've seen oceans floating in the sky, volcanoes blanketed in ash, and trees that touch the heavens. The wonders I've witnessed... they're simply too numerous and strange to fully describe.
8260857.ch: 我跟你说，这几十年来，我打开的洞天秘境也许比我吃过的饭还多。我在那里面看过在天空的大海，看见满是碳灰的火山，看见参天的巨树，稀奇古怪，说之不尽呢。

8260858.en: Because we made a promise back then.

8260859.en: I've found a way to counteract it. This world doesn't affect me much now. I just need to find a way to return periodically, and that's enough.
8260859.ch: 现今八荒对我影响不大，只需我定期设法回归自己位面即可。

8260861.en: Hey, you know what? I actually came back with countless stories to tell you. About all the mystic realms I've explored, the people I've met over the years, and all the bizarre things I've experienced.
8260861.ch: 喂，其实这次回来我有无数的话想跟你说，跟你说我去过的那些洞天，这些年来结识过的人，经历过的古怪事情。

8260862.en: But now that we're face to face, all those words I had bottled up... they've suddenly vanished.
8260862.ch: 但没想到真见面了，这一肚皮的话反而都说不上了。

8260863.en: Maybe... this time away has made me grow up? Or perhaps... it changed me?
8260863.ch: 也许，是这段时间让我长大了？让我……变了？

8260864.en: Our heart... it's an enigma, isn't it?
8260864.ch: 心……真是个让人搞不懂的东西啊。

8260865.en: Ao Yao stands up, resting her delicate hands on the desk as she gazes out the window. Her brows furrow as if she's wrestling with a particularly challenging thought.
8260865.ch: 敖瑶站了起来，素手支着案桌看向窗外，她的秀眉紧蹙，似乎正竭力思考着什么。

8260866.en: Ever since I returned, I've been wondering... if you've become less important to me.
8260866.ch: 从我回到八荒起始，我就一直在想……你是不是已经变得不重要了。

8260867.en: It's only now that I understand. It's not that you've become less important... It's just that time has smoothed out my rough edges, and in the process, I've become more serene and stable.
8260867.ch: 直到刚刚我才明白，不是这样的……只是这段时间把突出尖棱全部磨平了，而我却因此变得温润稳定。

8260868.en: Time may have tempered my passion, but it also made me realize just how important the thing I've been seeking all along truly is...
8260868.ch: 时间将激情磨灭了，但却让我明白一直以来追寻的东西是多么重要……

8260869.en: That day... that day I desperately tried to break free from the rift's pull... I wanted to throw myself into your arms and tell you everything! I would say, I didn't want to leave anymore. Life or death, it didn't matter—I wasn't going to go!
8260869.ch: 那天……那天我竭力想扑离裂隙的吸引牵制……想扑到你怀里，把一切告诉你！我不想走了，生也好，死也罢，我不走了！

8260870.en: But that day... in the end, I couldn't break free from the rift's pull. Today, however, nothing can hold me back anymore...
8260870.ch: 可是那天……最后我没能挣脱裂隙的牵引。但今天，再没什么能阻止我的了……

8260871.en: Just as you're about to turn and leave, a sudden waft of fragrance catches you off guard. Before you can react, Ao Yao sneaks up behind you and envelops you in a tight embrace...
8260871.ch: 你原本正打算转身离开，未料身后香风扑至，敖瑶已经从后掩至，一把将你紧紧抱住……

8260873.en: You're... Lady Frostdweller? The name doesn't seem to suit you at all. Well, never mind. So you're the one who's been secretly contacting me? All this sneaking around... If you hadn't pointed out those treasure spots beneath the Everfrost, I would never have handed this over to you. Here, take it. This is farewell.
8260873.ch: 你……是栖寒仙子？这名字总感觉和你不太像。罢了，便是你一直与我暗中联系吗？神神秘秘的，若非你指出冰原的冰下藏宝点，我绝不会将此物交予你手的。请收下，就此别过。

8260874.en: After saying these words, a faint blush colors her cheeks as she swiftly flies away on her sword.
8260874.ch: 她说了这话后，俏脸微微一红，便迅速转身御剑离开了。

8260875.en: I admire those who are truly devoted to one path. Only such people can achieve greatness, and only they can truly care for those around them.
8260875.ch: 我最喜欢一心一意的人了，也只有这样的人才能成就大事，也只有这样的人才会真正对身边的人好。

8260876.en: Have you ever seen how beautiful it is when someone is completely absorbed in what they're doing? There's something truly captivating about that level of focus.
8260876.ch: 你见过没，那些一心一意的人做事专心致志的样子，真的很好看呢。

8260877.en: I hope that someday, I'll find someone who won't chase after every pretty face or fall for sweet temptations—someone who'll be devoted to me and me alone.
8260877.ch: 我希望啊，以后能够有个人，他不会拈花惹草，不会理那些狂蜂浪蝶，只一心一意的对我好。

8260878.en: Haha, I suppose that's what every woman wishes for, isn't it?
8260878.ch: 哈哈，我猜这也是天下间女子的想法吧？

8260879.en: Hey! I saw you the other day—you have more than one partner, don't you? You rascal, are you going to do something bad to your true love in the future?
8260879.ch: 喂，我上次看见了，你有不止一个道侣吧？你这家伙，以后会不会对自己的挚爱不好的呀？

8260880.en: Hehe, you seem sincere enough—I'll trust you for now! Here, take these little trinkets as a gift!
8260880.ch: 嘻嘻，看你还是比较诚恳的人，暂且相信你！来，这些小东西送给你玩！

8260881.en: Haha, you're quite the practical one, aren't you? Not willing to be shortchanged even a bit! Here, have some little trinkets to play with!
8260881.ch: 哈哈，你这家伙，还是很实在的嘛，半点不肯吃亏！来，给你些小东西玩玩！

8260882.en: You know, I think I saw your wife during my last adventure. To be honest, I'm quite envious of her—having you all to herself, always by her side. Ah, even when exploring this vast wilderness, it would be nice to have someone special to share it with!
8260882.ch: 话说，上回在外探险好像看见你妻子了。说实话，我还挺嫉妒你妻子的，能独占着你，让你时常陪伴。哎呀，即使是在八荒探险，也是想有有个知心人陪着呢！

8260883.en: Yes... I hope that someday I'll find someone who truly loves me too. You helped me out last time, so I brought you some nice things—please take them.
8260883.ch: 是啊，希望有一天我也会有一个爱着我的人吧。上回你帮了我，我给你带了些好玩意，你拿着吧。

8260884.en: You know... you should spend more time with your beloved. You and I... we're just friends, after all. To be frank, I'm just someone on the outside.
8260884.ch: 其实啊，你应该多陪陪你的爱人。你和我啊，终究只是朋友。说难听一点，我只是个不相干的人呢。

8260885.en: Let's not dwell on such things. You helped me out last time, so I brought you some nice things—take them.
8260885.ch: 不说这些有的没的，上回你帮了我，我给你带了些好玩意，拿着吧。

8260886.en: To be honest, I find most cultivators in this realm rather ridiculous—so many of them chase multiple loves. You're different though. Even if you're just exploring around for now, I still hope you'll find someone who'll be truly devoted to you.
8260886.ch: 其实我感觉八荒的修士都挺荒唐的，三心二意的不少。你这样就挺好，虽然只是周围查探，但还是希望有个一心一意的人陪着呢。

8260887.en: That was a compliment, you know! Here, have a little reward—keep up the good work!
8260887.ch: 我这可是在夸你呢，来，给你点小奖励，再接再厉！

8260888.en: Oh? It's you. Shouldn't you be with your beloved? I'm surprised you have time to visit me.
8260888.ch: 啊？是你。不用陪你心爱的人吗？还有空来找我。

8260889.en: Oh? So when you find someone you like even more someday, will you cast me aside too?
8260889.ch: 哦？那有朝一日，你再遇见一个你更喜欢的人，是不是也把我晾起来？

8260890.en: Go on then. Someone who chose to marry you must truly love you very much.
8260890.ch: 快去吧，愿意和你结为夫妻的人，一定是很爱你的。

8260892.en: Ao Yao lets out a long sigh, then turns her gaze back to the misty horizon where water meets sky, lost in her thoughts.
8260892.ch: 敖瑶悠悠一叹，便又注视目前方水天烟光，暗自犯愁。

8260893.en: Oh, it's you. What brings you here?

8260894.en: We're not growing apart—we're still friends. But even friends need to maintain certain boundaries, right? *humph* Someday, I'll find someone I can share everything with too.
8260894.ch: 没有生分啊，我们还是朋友。但朋友之间也总该有一条底线守着吧？哼哼，以后我也会有一个无话不谈的人吧。

8260895.en: My friend, I found something nice while exploring the Mystic Realm last time. I got it especially for you as a gift!
8260895.ch: 朋友，这是上回我探索秘境摸到的好东西，是专门给你带的伴手礼！

8260896.en: You're always hanging around me—won't your special someone mind? If I were in their shoes, I wouldn't be happy about it. Besides, exploring the Mystic Realm is my responsibility; I shouldn't keep troubling you with it.
8260896.ch: 整天跟我混在一块，你身边的人不会介意吗？将心比心，换作是我就会不高兴了。而且查探秘境终究是我的事，不该劳烦你的。

8260899.en: We're nothing more than passing acquaintances—people meet and part as fate dictates. You have someone more deserving of your attention, yet you keep coming to me. How inappropriate! Don't come looking for me anymore!
8260899.ch: 我们是萍水相逢的朋友，缘来则聚，缘去则散。你身边有更值得关心的人，却总跑到我这边来，这成何体统呢？不要再来找我了！

8260900.en: Ao Yao is clearly furious. With an angry huff, she storms away without looking back.
8260900.ch: 敖瑶似乎十分生气，她哼的一声，头也不回地离开了。

8260901.en: What do you take me for? We're a man and a woman—there should be boundaries. You already have someone you love, yet you keep leading me on. Leave now. We shouldn't spend so much time together.
8260901.ch: 你当我是什么人呢？你我终究男女有别，而你已有心爱的人了，却还来招惹我？快快离开，我们不该老待在一起的。

8260903.en: You arrive at the young lady's dwelling to find it shrouded in darkness. The place feels desolately empty, with no one in sight. Only an elegant letter lies askew on the desk, written in Ao Yao's hand.
8260903.ch: 你来到龙女住处，只见周围一片漆黑，周围空落落的不见人影，只有案上斜放一张精美信笺，上面留有敖瑶字迹。

8260904.en: I'm sorry for treating you poorly before. I was dealing with my own troubles and frustrations—I shouldn't have taken them out on you.
8260904.ch: 对不起，我之前对你态度不好，这也是因为我自己郁闷的原因，我不该将这些烦恼发泄到你身上的。

8260905.en: Shall we explore the Mystic Realm together and discover new sights? What do you say?
8260905.ch: 我们去找秘境，去看没看过的风景，好不好？

8260906.en: It's been a long time, my friend. As promised, I've come back to see you.
8260906.ch: 好久不见了，朋友。我遵照诺言回来看你了。

8260907.en: You have no idea how much trouble I went through to return to the world! But I made it back at last. Hey, how come you haven't changed a bit? I've grown up, you know!
8260907.ch: 你可不知道，回到八荒，我费了好多心思呢，不过总算回来了。咦，你怎么还是老样子，我可是长大了哦。

8260908.en: I've always wanted to thank you properly. If I hadn't met you, I could never have done all this alone. You helped me see this journey through to the end.
8260908.ch: 其实我一直很想给你道个谢。如果不是遇见你，我一个人无法完成所有的事，是你帮助我走完这趟旅程的。

8260909.en: This journey has given me a whole new perspective on the universe and helped me understand my father's intentions. Remember this: Ao Yao will always be your dear friend!
8260909.ch: 也是这次旅程让对这个宇宙有了很多新的看法，让我体会到父王的苦心。记着，敖瑶永远都是你的好朋友！

8260910.en: Whenever I'm back, you'd better come hang out with me!
8260910.ch: 只要我回来，你都要找我玩噢！

8260911.en: (The Dragon Maiden appears in the residence, but she can only be your friend—romance is not possible.)
8260911.ch: 龙女出现在房子里，但无法结缘，只会和玩家做朋友。

8260912.en: You return to Ao Yao's dwelling and find her fragrance still lingering in the air—she must have left recently. Sunlight streams into the room, illuminating a letter lying askew on the desk. The page is filled with dense lines of writing.
8260912.ch: 你回到敖瑶的住处，发现馨香犹在，可见其人离去不久。此时日光落到屋内，照亮案桌，上面斜放一封信笺。上面密密麻麻的写着若干文字。

8261024.en: It's rare, but it's not a treasure
8261024.ch: 东西是罕有，但哪里是什么宝物了？

8261025.en: Hey! I know a really cool place I'd like to show you. You seem like a trustworthy person; do you care to come along with me?
8261025.ch: 喂！我有一个很不错的地方想找你跟我一起去逛逛，我看你还算是个实诚人，跟我来一趟怎样？

8261026.en: Listen, there is lots more good stuff over there! Look, I even brought some as a gift for you!
8261026.ch: 我跟你说，那边还有很多好东西哦，你看，我拿了些来送你！

8261027.en: By the water's edge, Ao Yao gazes at her reflection as she tosses stones into the water one by one, creating rippling circles across the surface.
8261027.ch: 敖瑶临水照影，手抓石头一个一个的抛到水中，荡起一圈圈涟漪。

8261029.en: She seems troubled by something. After muttering to herself for a moment, she turns and walks away.
8261029.ch: 她似乎正为什么事情烦恼，自言自语片刻后，便转身离开了。

8261030.en: Hehe, I saw it, <r>you're already married!</r> Hey, you better be treating your wife right!
8261030.ch: 嘿嘿，我看见了，<r>你这家伙已经有妻子了！</r>。喂喂，你会不会对你妻子不好的呀？

8261033.en: Ao Yao sits idly in the wilderness, fixing her gaze on the distant horizon where water meets sky, lost in thought.
8261033.ch: 敖瑶闲坐野郊，目视远方水天，似在思索什么事情。

8261035.en: No, no, no! Go on then. Someone who chose to marry you must truly love you very much.
8261035.ch: 别别别！快去吧，愿意和你结为夫妻的人，一定是很爱你的。

8261036.en: Ao Yao lets out a melancholic sigh, then turns her gaze back to the misty horizon where water meets sky, lost in her troubled thoughts and no longer acknowledging your presence.
8261036.ch: 敖瑶幽幽一叹，便又注视面前方水天烟光，暗自犯愁，不再理你。

8261037.en: Stop being silly, will you? Go. To. Your. Wife. Right. Now!
8261037.ch: 别犯傻了，好吗？快、去、陪、你、老、婆！

8261039.en: Oh hey, it's such nice weather! How about we go for a little stroll?
8261039.ch: 哎呀，天气很好啊，我们去溜达溜达怎样？

8261041.en: You know, I'd really like to wander around and take in the sights of the world.
8261041.ch: 其实啊，我还想周围走一走，看一看八荒的景色。

8261042.en: Don't think I'm being silly—you're probably the only one willing to keep me company now, aren't you? I know you cultivators like these sorts of things, so here, take this.
8261042.ch: 你不要觉得我荒唐，其实也只有你愿意陪着我了吧？我知道你们修士喜欢这些，送你呀。

8261043.en: Ao Yao stands by the lake, its mirror-like surface reflecting every detail of her features.
8261043.ch: 敖瑶站在湖边，面前水平如镜，照出敖瑶面目五官。

8261044.en: Oh Ao Yao, dear Ao Yao... Have you ever seen how beautiful it is when someone is completely absorbed in what they're doing? There's something truly captivating about that level of focus.
8261044.ch: 敖瑶啊敖瑶，你见过没，那些一心一意的人做事专心致志的样子，真的很好看呢。

8261055.en: I'm sorry—I didn't mean to be so harsh last time. I've regretted those words ever since.
8261055.ch: 对不起，上次我不是有意思说重话的，那之后我也很后悔。

8261056.en: I'm truly grateful for all the times you've accompanied me on adventures and explored the Mystic Realms with me. This is my way of making amends—please don't be angry anymore.
8261056.ch: 其实我很感激你一直陪着我四处冒险，查探秘境的。这时赔礼，你不要生气好吗？

8261057.en: Ao Yao stands by the water's edge, gazing at her reflection. One by one, she picks up pebbles and tosses them into the water, creating ripples that bloom like flowers on the surface.
8261057.ch: 敖瑶立在水岸边上，凝视水中倒影，她捡起石子一个个抛到水中，绽起朵朵水花。

8261094.en: {name|B} moves her fingers with delicate grace. Frost gathers at her fingertips, swirling like celestial clouds through countless formations. As she channels her energy, the misty vapors coalesce into the form of a snow-white rabbit...
8261094.ch: 只见{name|B}，手指轻动，指尖处聚起寒气，仿佛天上烟云，变化万方，但随她运转灵力，烟气最终化为一只雪白的兔子……

8261095.en: You know how it always goes with me—people end up despising me, treating me like an enemy. And I always end up hurting others without meaning to. Could {name|A} actually be sincere about caring for me?
8261095.ch: 你是知道我的，最后总不免被人嫌弃，遭人敌视，而我也会在不经意间伤害了旁人。{name|A}仿佛是真心对我好的？

8261096.en: I hope someone can take care of and treat well that silly one. Say... perhaps I should suggest that {name|A} pay more attention to {gender1|A} friends and potential partners? After all, having someone by your side is what makes life beautiful.
8261096.ch: 我希望有人能够照顾这家伙，对这家伙好。你说，我要不说说，让{name|A}留意一下身边的朋友、道侣？毕竟有人陪着是一件幸福的事情啊。

8261097.en: She plays with the jade rabbit for a while, then lets out a soft, sudden sigh. As she withdraws her energy, the frost disperses, and the jade rabbit fades away. She, too, rises and takes her leave.
8261097.ch: 她逗弄那玉兔半晌，蓦地轻轻一叹，收回灵力，寒气溃散，玉兔化去，她亦起身离去了。

8261098.en: The woman before you waves her fingers, conjuring wisps of mist that take the form of a snow rabbit. As it scampers around her, she occasionally reaches out to play with it. A faint smile breaks through her usually frost-like expression.
8261098.ch: 面前女子指间晃动，举起一团烟气化为雪兔，在她身边来回奔走，她偶尔伸手逗弄雪兔，冷冰冰的脸上偶尔泛起一丝笑意。

8261099.en: Some of the people around {name|A} are good folks, but others... not so much. I must give that silly one some advice—to stay close to those who truly care for {gender2|A}, and keep away from those who might lead {gender2|A} into danger.
8261099.ch: {name|A}身边有些人是不错的，有些人却不那么好。我一定要给这家伙一点建议，让{gender|A}亲近那些真心对{gender|A}好的，疏远那些会让{gender|A}陷入危险之中的人。

8261100.en: As long as someone can truly stay by {gender1|A} side and care for {gender2|A}, I can rest easy. Alas. I wish someone would stay by my side too... but that's just a foolish dream, isn't it?
8261100.ch: 只要有人能真心陪伴{gender|A}，照顾{gender|A}，我就安心了。唉，很希望有人能一直陪着我，但这只是奢望吧？

8261101.en: The woman talks to herself, but her words soon give way to streams of tears flowing down her cheeks. Through stifled sobs, she dispels the frost from her fingers and rises. With graceful steps, she departs, soon vanishing into the distance.
8261101.ch: 面前女子自言自语，但说着说着泪水便从她眼中哗啦啦的流下来了。饮泣声中她收回指间寒气，重新站起，莲步轻踏，人早去得远了。

8261102.en: {name|C} is a truly selfless person who values friendship deeply. Why not try getting closer to the person? That way, you could look after each other. What do you think?
8261102.ch: {name|C}为人大公无私，重视朋友，我觉得你不妨多与其亲近，如此一来，你们也可以互相照料。你觉得呢？

8261103.en: That's wonderful! You should find some time to have a good talk with each other. It would be a great chance to deepen your friendship.
8261103.ch: 那太好了，你们应该找个机会好好聊聊，好让彼此情谊更进一步。

8261104.en: Sigh... Well, it's natural for people to have different opinions about each other.
8261104.ch: 唉……彼此间见解不同也是常有的。

8261105.en: {name|C} is an upstanding person who always looks out for others. I truly hope your friendship continues to flourish.
8261105.ch: {name|C}这人正直仗义，总爱照顾旁人。我真盼望你们之间的交情能一直保持下去。

8261106.en: I'm so glad you feel the same way. Sure, they might do some odd things from time to time, but when it comes down to it, they'll stand by you through thick and thin.
8261106.ch: 你也能这么想就太好了。此人也许会偶尔做出一点奇怪的事来，但总体来说，还是愿意与你共经患难的。

8261107.en: Oh... you don't like them? I'm sorry, I shouldn't have pried. I-I should get going.
8261107.ch: 啊……原来你不喜欢吗，对不起，是我多嘴了。我、我先走了。

8261108.en: I've noticed you and {name|C} have grown quite close lately. They have a kind heart—the type of friend who'll stand by you in both fortune and hardship.
8261108.ch: 近日看你与{name|C}来往甚密，此人仁心善良，既能同富贵，也能共患难。

8261109.en: Take care to maintain a good relationship with each other, and don't let fleeting emotions lead to conflict. I hope you can support and look after one another—after all, life throws plenty of challenges our way each day.
8261109.ch: 你们彼此之间也要好好相处，不要为了一时意气起了冲突。希望你们能够彼此照顾，互相扶持，毕竟每天迎面而来的事情都太多了。

8261110.en: I have matters to attend to. Please excuse me.

8261111.en: I-I had no idea you thought so poorly of them... This is my fault... I-I should go.
8261111.ch: 没、没想到你是这么看轻此人的……是我不好……我、我先走了。

8261112.en: While {name|C} has a gentle nature and treats everyone equally, that might not be ideal. It's a noble quality, but for someone close to you... wouldn't it be better to find someone who would dedicate themselves completely to you?
8261112.ch: {name|C}虽然性子平和，但对待所有人都一视同仁。原本这是极好的，但作为关系亲密的人，还是找一个愿意全心全意为你的人更好。

8261113.en: You... you understand my concerns. That's a relief. I, um, have some matters to attend to, so I'll take my leave.
8261113.ch: 你……能体会我的苦心，那是最好了。我，还有事，先走一步了。

8261114.en: Sigh. You have your own views on this. I shouldn't have said anything.
8261114.ch: 唉，你有自己的看法，是我不好。

8261115.en: {name|C} is rather arrogant, and I worry the person's reckless behavior will attract unnecessary enemies—and you'll get dragged into it. You should try to talk some sense into the person. There are many master cultivators in the world, and such pride will surely lead to disaster sooner or later.
8261115.ch: {name|C}较为狂妄，我总担心此人会无端招来仇恨，牵连于你。你啊，最好多加规劝，不然八荒大能甚多，早晚要吃亏的。

8261116.en: Well, you can't go wrong keeping company with good people.
8261116.ch: 反正亲近好人总是错不了的。

8261117.en: I-I've said too much. I should go.

8261118.en: I had no idea you felt this way... I'm sorry... I shouldn't have meddled.
8261118.ch: 我没想到你是这么想的，抱歉……是我管太多了。

8261119.en: I have some matters to attend to. I'll take my leave.

8261120.en: I see you and {name|B} have formed quite a bond. Listen—one's achievements should match one's magnanimity. Someone who spends all their time settling scores and thinking only of themselves will never accomplish anything worthwhile.
8261120.ch: 你与{name|抓来的npc}之间的情谊看来不错。我觉得啊人能造多大功业就需多大胸襟，否则一天到晚在月头月尾的时候找人寻仇，眼里只有自己，就什么都耽误了。

8261121.en: We should try to guide with gentle words and hope they'll change their ways. Otherwise, they'll end up bringing trouble to everyone around them.
8261121.ch: 我们需以良言规劝，希望其尽量改过才是。否则这家伙早晚会祸及身边之人。

8261122.en: Exactly—while it's best when people look out for each other, I'm worried this troublemaker will drag you into their mess.
8261122.ch: 就是，彼此之间能够互相照顾那是最好，我就怕这家伙四处惹事，把你也牵连了。

8261123.en: ...I've been too forward, speaking my mind without thinking. I'm truly sorry.
8261123.ch: ……都是我莽撞，随口就说了这些。实在抱歉。

8261124.en: I see you've grown close to {name|B}, but I'm concerned. They seem to harbor ill intentions and show no regard for others' feelings. People like that tend to drag down those around them. Perhaps you should keep them at arm's length?
8261124.ch: 你与{name|抓来的npc}交情不错，但我觉得此人满心邪念，从来不顾他人感受，恐怕会连累身边的人。你要不要适当保持一下距离？

8261125.en: I fear you'll get caught up in their troubles and find yourself in danger...
8261125.ch: 我怕你会被此人牵连，陷入危险之中……

8261126.en: Try having a heart-to-heart with them first, but if that doesn't work out, maybe it's best not to get too close.
8261126.ch: 你好好跟这人说一说，实在不行啊，就不要深交了。

8261127.en: I'm glad you understand what I mean. I'll take my leave now.
8261127.ch: 你既能体会到这层就好了，我先走了。

8261128.en: ...Letting emotions run unchecked isn't always for the best. I've been too forward, speaking my mind without thinking. I'm truly sorry.
8261128.ch: ……一味放任性情，也不见得就好。都是我莽撞，随口就说了这些。实在抱歉。

8261129.en: I have some matters to attend to, so I'll be going now...

8261130.en: I've noticed you spending time with Lan You lately. While her methods may walk the line between light and shadow, she has a righteous heart as noble as the lonely bamboo or orchid, a true lady of virtue.
8261130.ch: 近日看你与兰幽来往，我观此人行事颇有几分亦正亦邪的感觉，但她内心正义，可比孤竹香兰，乃是个女君子。

8261131.en: However, her quick wit and deep cunning mean that danger follows wherever she goes. For your own sake, it might be wise to keep some distance from her at times.
8261131.ch: 只是，她机智百出，城府深处，与她在一起，总不免伴随危机。为了你自己着想，有些时候还是与她保持一点距离较好。

8261132.en: The world is vast, and danger lurks everywhere. I'm glad you're heeding my advice to avoid unnecessary risks. I just hope Lan You doesn't let her obsessions consume her—making enemies everywhere will only lead to her own downfall.
8261132.ch: 八荒广大，处处都是危机，你能听我劝说，尽量不要冒一些不必要的险也是好的。希望兰幽也不要太过执着，否则处处树敌，把她自己都耽误了。

8261133.en: I won't take up any more of your time. I'll take my leave now.
8261133.ch: 不耽误你的事，我这便先行离开了。

8261134.en: Alas. I just worry Lan You will bring you nothing but trouble. But the choice is yours to make. I'll be going now.
8261134.ch: 唉，我只是怕兰幽会给你带来不必要的麻烦。你自己决定吧，我先走了。

8261135.en: I see you've been spending time with that mysterious woman, Yin'er. Actually, I... I sense a mysterious power coursing through her. She might be like me—no, she's constantly haunted by this power, destined to face endless hardships.
8261135.ch: 近日你似乎与那神秘女子银耳来往。其实，我……总觉得她身上充斥一股神秘的力量。她可能和我一样，不，她总是会被这股力量纠缠，以至于命途多难。

8261136.en: I worry that by associating with her, you'll inevitably get dragged into some dangerous situations...
8261136.ch: 我总会担心，你和她相处同行，总不免卷入某些不好的事当中……

8261137.en: Yes, exactly. Though her situation is pitiful, you can't save everyone...
8261137.ch: 嗯，就是这个道理。她虽然可怜，但你没办法帮助每一个人的……

8261139.en: Sigh. Everyone has their own destiny to face. There's only so much you can do to help her.
8261139.ch: 唉，每个人都有自己的宿命，你没办法帮她太多的。

8261140.en: I've noticed you spending time with that young lady, Ao Yao. Pardon my interference, but while she's a wonderful girl—kind-hearted and cheerful—she has this habit of venturing into mysterious caves.
8261140.ch: 近日，我仿佛看见你与那名叫敖瑶的少女在一起。请你勿怪我多嘴，敖瑶开朗善良，本是一个极好的姑娘。只是她总爱冒险查探各种神秘洞天。

8261141.en: Think about it—these caves have remained sealed for thousands of years. Who knows what dangers lurk within? Rushing in blindly won't always end well. While looking after your own safety, please try to discourage that young lady from being so reckless in her adventures.
8261141.ch: 你想，那些洞天几千几百年来无人开启探索，里面不知潜藏多少危机，仓促进入，不见得每次都能履险如夷。你顾惜自己的同时，也请劝劝那小姑娘，不要总是四处冒险。

8261142.en: Yes! I only spoke up because I fear you might be walking into danger without realizing it. I hope you won't take my concerns the wrong way.
8261142.ch: 嗯！我只怕你深陷危险而不自知，这才多嘴提议，盼你不要介意。

8261143.en: But now that I know we're of the same mind, I can rest easy. I'll take my leave.
8261143.ch: 不过我知道你心中想法与我一样就放心了，我先走了。

8261144.en: Oh... I understand. I shouldn't have pried. I'm sorry, I-I should get going.
8261144.ch: 唔……我明白了，是我多嘴了。对不起，我、我先走了。

8261145.en: While walking, a sudden tremor of spiritual energy courses through your body. In the distance, a frost-white aura rises into the air as gusts of freezing wind blow in, bringing with them an unbearable chill.
8261145.ch: 行走之际，体内灵机一震，产生感应。同时远方升腾一股霜白之气，阵阵冰风从远处刮来，叫人极感不适。

8261146.en: That's coming from {name|B}'s residence... why is there such a sudden surge of frost energy?
8261146.ch: 那是{name|B}住处的方向，为何突然间寒气大盛……？

8261147.en: Ahead, {name|B} sits in meditation as waves of frost energy surge around her. Upon sensing someone nearby, she opens her eyes to look at you. The cold intensifies; frigid winds whirl about as a thin layer of frost forms on her body.
8261147.ch: 只见前方{name|B}于地上打坐，阵阵寒气在周围涌来涌去。但她察觉到附近有人立即睁开眼朝你看来，同时寒气一盛，周围寒风阵阵，她身上结起薄薄冰霜。

8261148.en: W-what are you doing here? Get away! My energy is getting out of control, and frost power is about to burst out—you'll get caught in it if you stay!
8261148.ch: 你、你怎么在这？快走开，我体内灵力失衡，寒气即将散泄，留在此处你会受到牵连。

8261149.en: Sigh. This is foolish... h-how could you possibly help? Well, fine. Find me the Heaven Aura—that should suppress this frost energy for now.
8261149.ch: 唉，真是胡闹……你、你怎么帮得了？也罢，帮我找来天道之气，应能暂时压抑体内寒气。

8261151.en: With your help, {name|B}'s frost energy gradually comes under control.
8261151.ch: {name|B}得你之助，寒气渐渐得到压制。

8261152.en: I never thought it would come to this... The frost within me grows more unstable by the day. You see? One day I might just turn into an ice statue, and that'll be the end of me.
8261152.ch: 没想到会是这样的下场……最近体内寒气是越来越不稳定了。看见了吗？也许有一天我突然就变成了冰棍子，彻底就没了。

8261153.en: You know what? From the bottom of my heart, I hope you find true friends to stand by your side. That way, when hardships come, you'll have people to help you, care for you, and face those challenges together.
8261153.ch: 你知道吗？我打心底希望你能找到几个知心人为伴，如以一来，即使日后有困难也有人帮助你，照顾你，和你一起渡过难关。

8261154.en: Time and again, I've tried to guide you, urging you to befriend those worthy of your trust and stay away from those who would put you at risk. But you never heed my advice!
8261154.ch: 谁料我几次探问，希望你能和值得深交的人交往，疏远那些会给你带来风险的人，你都不听我的建议！

8261155.en: No one can help me... just go away...
8261155.ch: 没有谁能帮到我……你走开……

8261156.en: Ah! Yes! I want to help you too, to stay by your side, to walk this path together. I've been hoping you would do the same for me!
8261156.ch: 啊！是啊！我也想帮你，陪着你，一直走下去，我也盼着你能帮我陪着我一直走下去。

8261157.en: You have no idea how many times I've fallen into despair! All I want is to be rid of this icy energy; I've tried to forcefully purge it from my body, but every attempt ends in Qi backlash, only making the frost within me grow stronger!
8261157.ch: 你都不知道我已经绝望了多少次！我只想撇开这身寒气，我想强行剥离这身寒气，但每次都灵气逆冲，只有白白的助长了体内寒气的增长！

8261158.en: If it weren't for you, would I be tormenting myself like this? Get away! Leave me alone!
8261158.ch: 如果不是你，我会这样折腾自己吗？你走开！走开！

8261159.en: You... you're spouting nonsense, nothing but nonsense!
8261159.ch: 你……净会胡说八道，净会胡说八道！

8261160.en: With tears streaming down {name|B}'s face, she turns away with a sweep of her sleeve and rushes off.
8261160.ch: {name|B}泪眼滂沱，一拂袖便转身奔走而去了。

8261161.en: It's all because of my foolish, one-sided feelings! I brought this misery upon myself... I never should have done this!
8261161.ch: 都是我一厢情愿，作践自己，才生出这些波折，我不该这样的！

8261162.en: {name|B} suddenly bursts into tears, turning her face away before hurrying off, disappearing into the distance in the blink of an eye.
8261162.ch: {name|B}突然哭了起来，她一把别过了脸，转身急步而去，眨眼间就去得远了。

8261163.en: I've known it all along! I've known it all along! After all these years, what is there left for me to figure out? This path—I must walk it alone! No one can stay by my side!
8261163.ch: 我早就想明白了！我早就想明白了！这么多年来过去了，我还有什么没琢磨明白吗？这路永远只能我一个人走完！没有人能陪着我！

8261165.en: You're right. I can barely take care of myself—how could I possibly help you? Just go. You've done enough for me already...
8261165.ch: 你说得不错，我自顾不暇，又哪里轮到我来帮你呢？你走吧，你帮过我了……

8261167.en: {name|B} appears deeply moved, her face cycling through a whirlwind of emotions—sorrow, hesitation, shock. As tears well up in her eyes, she hurriedly turns away, not even bothering to summon her Flying Sword before rushing off.
8261167.ch: {name|B}似受到触动，脸上表情数变，难过、犹豫、震惊不一而足。最后她双眼漫上泪水，忙一转身别过脸去，顾不得招来飞剑，急匆匆的离开了。

8261168.en: Yes... From the very beginning, I knew that in this life, I could only rely on myself. I was always destined to walk this path alone!
8261168.ch: 是啊，打一开始，我就知道今生今世，我都只能靠自己，我都只能一个人孤孤单单的走下去！

8261169.en: With a face as cold as frost, {name|B} refuses your helping hand, struggling to stand on her own. With a sweep of her sleeves, she gracefully vanishes from sight.
8261169.ch: {name|B}脸若寒霜，她不顾你搀，扶挣扎着站起，拂袖间，人已翩然而去了。

8261170.en: The area is covered in icicles like countless sharp spears pointing toward the heavens. Frost blankets the ground, and a trail of snow winds its way forward like a serpent, creating a broken path that leads to Shuang Ling's dwelling.
8261170.ch: 只见此地结满冰凌，仿佛支支利锥，斜指天际，周围寒霜满地，只见地上一道霜雪宛如龙蛇，断断续续，蜿蜒远去，通向霜凌住处。

8261171.en: Could something have happened to her... Should I check her residence?
8261171.ch: 莫非……她出了意外……要不要去她的住处看看？

8261172.en: The house ahead stands completely empty. Cobwebs crisscross the interior, and a thick layer of dust blankets the desk. It seems the owner has long since departed.
8261172.ch: 只见前方屋舍空落落的并无一人，里面蛛丝纵横，案桌上厚厚的铺着一层尘埃，看来主人已经离开了。

8261173.en: Fearing she would become a burden to you, {name|B} has vanished from the world. You will likely never cross paths again.
8261173.ch: {name|B}因为害怕自己而牵累于你，她这一去怕是从此绝迹八荒，永无相见之日了。

8261207.en: Shuang Ling looks at you hesitantly, seeming to have words caught in her throat. After several attempts to speak, she finally turns and departs on her sword.
8261207.ch: 霜凌看了看你，脸上尽是迟疑之色，几番欲言又止，终于还是转身御剑离开了。

8261211.en: Don't cry out! I've imagined this moment hundreds of times—you're my best friend! We've always been so happy together, so let's not turn this into a tearful scene! Right?!
8261211.ch: 你别喊！我想过千百次这样的场景，你是我最好的朋友！以往我们都是开开心心的，别现在却哭哭啼啼的！对不对！

8261212.en: Despite her words, tears stream freely down her cheeks.
8261212.ch: 话虽如此，她眼泪却哗啦啦的从眼角流了下来。

8261213.en: Sigh. Look at you, making such a scene! You're acting like we'll never see each other again—I'm just going home, that's all!
8261213.ch: 唉，都是你把状况搞得那么难看！整得好像生离死别一样，我这就是回家而已嘛！

8261214.en: Hey! How can you be so cold?! I've always thought of you as my sister! And now you won't even say a word!
8261214.ch: 喂，你就这么冷漠啊！我都把你当成好姐妹了！你竟然不一句话都不说！

8261215.en: Of course! Once I'm back home, I'll find a way to come see you again! Wait for me!
8261215.ch: 那是当然，我回去以后也会想办法回来看你的！你等我！

8261216.en: Ao Yao grits her teeth and whirls around, letting the rift's pull draw her in. The light of the rift dims as she vanishes, and in an instant, the crack seals itself shut, leaving only silence behind.
8261216.ch: 敖瑶咬了咬牙，一把转过身去，任由裂隙吸力将自己吸了进去，那道裂缝的光芒同时黯淡下去，只一瞬间罅隙弥合，一切重归寂然。

8261217.en: Hah! Ao Yao will always be Ao Yao! I'll never change! I'll keep wandering wherever I please, keep defying my royal father, and keep thinking about my best friend!
8261217.ch: 呸！敖瑶就是敖瑶！永远都不会变的！我还会四处游玩，还会不听父王的话，还会想着我最好的朋友！

8261221.en: Yes, I hope things will be different this time. Then I can finally live like everyone else without having to worry about being a burden to others.
8261221.ch: 是啊，希望这次真的能不一样。那以后我就能和平常人一样，再也不用怕牵累旁人了。

8261222.en: Then I can finally be your true companion without worry. When that time comes, I hope we can become sworn sisters—inseparable friends who cultivate together by day and share stories late into the night.
8261222.ch: 那时候我也能安安心心的跟你作伴，到那时，我希望你跟我做一对金兰姐妹，彼此相伴，白日一起修炼，夜里联床夜话。

8261223.en: {name|B} walks and talks with hopeful anticipation, a rare smile softening her usually stern face. However, at that very moment, several cultivators suddenly appear, shouting as they block your path.
8261223.ch: {name|B}怀着憧憬边说边走，一向冷冰冰的脸竟然少有地透出一丝笑意。然而就在此时，数名修士突然现身吆喝，拦住你两。

8261225.en: Though the cold aura around her gradually subsides, she remains focused on stabilizing her inner energy. You decide to step away for now, not wanting to disturb {name|B} during her meditation.
8261225.ch: 她身上的寒意逐渐被压服，但仍专心稳定体内灵力。你只有暂时离开，好不打扰{name|B}行功。

8261226.en: Hearing your words, her eyes overflow with tears. She slumps against a nearby tree and breaks into uncontrollable sobs, as if years of pent-up sorrow are finally being released through her tears.
8261226.ch: ta听了你这话，那眼睛之中泪水更是汹涌而出，她一下靠在身边的树上，放声痛哭，似乎要把所有的委屈全部哭了出来。

7009762.en: Even after my death, my son will take over, and after his death, my grandson will take over. I trust that, one day, we'll move these accursed mountains for sure!
7009762.ch: 即便我死了，我的儿子也会继承我的意志，我孙子又会继承我儿子的意志……我相信终有一日，我们定能将此山移走！

7009764.en: Someone is shooting arrows at me and my brothers and sisters! I'm all alone and have nowhere to turn!
7009764.ch: 有人想要射杀我和我的兄弟姐妹们！如今我落单，只怕是在劫难逃！

7009765.en: Remember, do not kill all of them... This world still needs the existence of the sun... Mm... After that, it's in your hands...
7009765.ch: 你切记，万不可赶尽杀绝……这个世界还需要太阳的存在……嗯……之后，便交给你了……

7009766.en: I will fill in this sea! ... You'd better leave... It's coming again!
7009766.ch: 我要填平这片海域！……你快离开吧……它又要过来了！！

7009767.en: The Xirang is needed to control the Blood Lord. I cannot give it to you unless the Blood Lord is eliminated first!
7009767.ch: 压制血魔离不开息壤，这血魔一日不除，我便不能将息壤交给你！

7009768.en: I'm so glad you saved me, otherwise who knows what they'd do to me...
7009768.ch: 还好你救了我！否则，真不知道他们会怎么对待我……

7009770.en: I just can't do it, Little One. You must follow the sun, and find out where she comes down...
7009770.ch: 我实在不行了，小不点，你一定要追上太阳，看看她到底会落在哪里呀……

7009771.en: But I don't think Heavenly Path will allow the world to perish on account of it. There must be something we can do to fix it... when the time is right...
7009771.ch: 但我相信，天道必不会放任八荒山海就此沉沦，一定存在某种破解之法，只是时机未到……

7009772.en: A mere insect knows that all things are equal. I'm impressed.
7009772.ch: 区区蝼蚁，也知晓万物平等之理，你倒算令我刮目相看。

7009775.en: Indeed, it is I. I trust you have been well since we last met.
7009775.ch: 正是老身，小友别来无恙。

7009777.en: Only a few days have passed since I last saw you, and you have already reached the Bottleneck of the Transcendent Middle. You are this one last stage away from reaching the peak of the World Cultivator Realm...
7009777.ch: 数日未见，小友已达登仙中期之瓶颈，离登临八荒修仙境界之巅也只差这最后一关……

7009778.en: As a person of this level of cultivation, I have not met another in a thousand years.
7009778.ch: 身具这等仙缘之人，千年之内，老身还没遇见过第二个。

7009779.en: Dreams... reality... are but a fleeting thought in your mind. What is real? What is hallucination? If this cannot be fully grasped, how are we different from mortals?
7009779.ch: 梦也罢，现实也罢，不过是你内心一瞬的念想……何为真实，何为虚幻，若不能将此参透，又与凡人何异？

7009780.en: To suddenly have nothing now, does not mean that there will not be any in the future. To not suddenly have something now, does not mean that there are those who used to have it. Different times... You can meditate upon these words...
7009780.ch: 今有之忽无，非昔无之未有；今无之忽有，非昔有之未无者，异乎时也，你可静心感悟此言……

7009781.en: Seeking the Tao of immortality need not be rushed. If the Taoist Mind is misunderstood, the result will not be beautiful.
7009781.ch: 求仙问道，倒不必急于一时，若因此误了道心，反而不美。

7009782.en: May I ask if you know where this last stage is?
7009782.ch: 我且问你，你可知这最后一道关，究竟在何处？

7009784.en: Cultivators on the path to immortality will have to cut ties with the mortal plane, more or less. If you have too many attachments, they may block your intent to reach greater heights.
7009784.ch: 修仙之人多少要割舍凡尘羁绊，可若真的太过绝情，便也阻断了念头通达的可能。

7009785.en: Scenes of the past come to mind. Thinking of the years of hard work to get to this path, you have mixed feelings, and the figure of Houtu grows hazy because of your thoughts.
7009785.ch: 昔日情景一幕幕涌上心头，想着多年苦修终得证道，你心中百感交集，眼前后土的身影也因你的思虑而变得虚幻起来。

7009786.en: Yes... Realm Breakthrough is the structure by which to open up new horizons, and enhance the mind. It is not just growth of the muscles and meridians...
7009786.ch: 嗯……境界突破原本就是格局之开拓、心性之提升，绝非一点筋骨经脉的成长而已……

7009787.en: As you quietly comprehend the change in your spirit from your Qi Refining to the Transcendent stage, you have mixed feelings, and the figure of Houtu grows hazy because of your thoughts.
7009787.ch: 静静体悟着自炼气到登仙以来精神的变化，你心中百感交集，眼前后土的身影也因你的思虑而变得虚幻起来。

7009788.en: The Heavenly Path is merciless... However, there is no turning back once you have stepped on the path to immortality. You must realize this...
7009788.ch: 天道无情……然而踏上仙途，本就没有了退路，想必你亦有此觉悟……

7009789.en: As you focus, you catch a glimpse of the majesty of the Heavenly Path Destiny. You have mixed feelings, and the figure of Houtu grows hazy because of your thoughts.
7009789.ch: 凝神感知之下，天道气运的磅礴浩然你已能窥见一斑，你心中百感交集，眼前后土的身影也因你的思虑而变得虚幻起来。

7009790.en: Good! I didn't expect the turning point to arise so quickly...
7009790.ch: 好！没想到契机这么快便出现了……

7009791.en: I condensed your Bottleneck into this illusory body while you were thinking. If you can defeat it, your journey to the Transcendent Realm will be a straightforward one with no obstacles!
7009791.ch: 我方才已于你动念之时，将你的瓶颈凝结为此幻身，若能将其击败，则你登仙之境便是一片坦途、再无阻隔！

7009792.en: The Mirror Image of Houtu has appeared in the world. I must head to Chi You to start the challenge...
7009792.ch: 后土幻身现于世间，我需要前往赤幽州进行挑战……

7009793.en: Violent roars keep coming from Chi You, and the skies have been dyed red and blue. I fear something abnormal is happening, so it is best to first go find out what is going on...
7009793.ch: 赤幽州方向不断传来剧烈轰鸣，天空被染上了红蓝二色，恐有异象，还是先前往一探究竟吧……

7009800.en: I didn't expect you to be {appellation|A}. This challenge won't be as easy as before.
7009800.ch: 想不到你还是{appellation|A}，那这次挑战可不会跟之前一样轻松了。

9000001.en: The sun burns in the sky as you walk in the Wayward Desert. You spot several monsters appearing in the distance, throwing up yellow sand into the sky as they rapidly approach you.
9000001.ch: 烈日当空，你行走在迷途荒漠之上，远方突然惊现数只妖兽，携着漫天黄沙，快速地向你逼近。

9000002.en: This is a very dangerous place that normal people cannot enter. What is your name and origin?
9000002.ch: 此地十分凶险，平常人不易进入，请教阁下姓名来历。

9000003.en: What? You are a cultivator who is coming from the Nether Mountains after they collapsed? Follow me and don't linger out here! My name is Gu Yuan'er, a disciple of the Cultivator Alliance of Chi You.
9000003.ch: 嗯？你是在冥山崩裂后从那边过来的修仙者？快跟我来，不要在外久留！在下顾鸢儿，赤幽州仙盟弟子！

9000004.en: You follow Gu Yuan'er, and suddenly a monster appears out of nowhere and stands in your way.
9000004.ch: 你跟随顾鸢儿行走，但面前突然扑出一只妖兽。

9000005.en: This is a Chi You monster possessed by the Nether Air, and it is very strong. But don't worry, I will protect you!
9000005.ch: 这是赤幽州中被冥气控制的妖兽，十分强大。道友莫怕，我来保护你！

9000006.en: As they approach, you discover that there is a woman in front of the monsters, fighting them by herself. Due to the large number of monsters, she is already showing signs of exhaustion.
9000006.ch: 其行至近处，你发现妖兽前方竟有一女子在独自和它们战斗，由于妖兽数量颇多，此人已有力竭之迹象。

9000008.en: The monsters of this land are different from the ones you've seen. You decide to observe for a while, but some monsters appear from behind you.
9000008.ch: 由于此地妖兽和以往所见不同，你决定观望一番，不料竟又有几只妖兽从你身后出现。

9000009.en: Gu Yuan'er has lost the battle and is running toward you. The monster gives a roar and starts to chase after her...
9000009.ch: 顾鸢儿与妖兽交锋失利，慌不择路朝你面前冲来，而那只妖兽发一声嘶吼，则猛追顾鸢儿而来……

9000010.en: Not bad! It's your first fight with monsters corrupted by Nether Air and you're able to hold your own. You're much better than those people who came before you!
9000010.ch: 不错嘛，第一次和被冥气侵蚀的妖兽交战，就打得有模有样，比起以前过来的那些人，厉害多了！

9000011.en: I grew up in Chi You, and I know all the Cultivators here!
9000011.ch: 本姑娘从小就在赤幽州长大，这里的修士没有我不认识的，你说呢！

9000012.ch: 哼哼，本姑娘厉害的地方多着呢！

9000013.en: My name's Gu Yuan'er. You can call me Yuan'er. Oh, right, what are you doing here? Nether Demons are everywhere! It's dangerous!
9000013.ch: 我叫顾鸢儿， 你叫我鸢儿就好。对了，你来这里干嘛，到处是冥妖，很危险的。

9000014.en: Tian Yuan Mountain, huh? It's deep in Chi You. It's said to be guarded by the Demonic god, Xingtian, and the path there is full of monsters. Are you sure you want to go there?
9000014.ch: 天元山吗，那可是在赤幽州深处啊，据说有魔神刑天在镇守，一路上更是有诸多妖兽，你确定要去吗？

9000015.en: At the question, you recall your arduous cultivation journey, your past brushes with death in battles, and the call in the beginning to "go to Tian Yuan Mountain," and you are as determined as ever.
9000015.ch: 听到对方的询问，你回想起这么多年的修行之路，那些与死亡擦肩而过的战斗，以及最初那一声“到天元山来”，你内心坚定如往昔。

9000016.en: I will go despite the danger.
9000016.ch: 纵然前方百般险阻，我也要去。

9000017.en: Since you've decided on it, come with me to the Cultivator Alliance. We are the frontline of the Chi You human resistance against the wave of monsters!
9000017.ch: 你既然决定了，那便跟我先回仙盟，仙盟可是我们人族在赤幽州对抗兽潮的前线！

9000018.en: The Nether Air is overflowing in Chi You, and the monsters mutate after being corrupted by the Nether Air. They gather once in a while to attack the Cultivator Alliance. We call them the wave of monsters.
9000018.ch: 对呀，赤幽州冥气外溢，这里的妖兽被冥气侵蚀后，就会发生变异，每隔一段时间就会聚集在一起，对仙盟发起猛攻，久而久之，我们就称之为兽潮了。

9000019.en: The monsters have high combat ability, but are not intelligent. They have always acted alone, so why are they behaving in this way now?
9000019.ch: 妖兽武力虽强，但灵智低下，一直都是单独行事，怎会有此规模性的行动？

9000020.en: Because there are Nether Demons here on top of monsters. They are powerful, cultivate with Nether Air, and are able to take human form. The strong ones among them have become transcendent cultivators, and can command monsters.
9000020.ch: 因为这里除了妖兽，还有冥妖，他们实力强悍，用冥气修行，可化人形，其中实力强的堪比登仙修士，甚至还可以指挥妖兽。

9000021.en: Fortunately, the Nether Air has not dispersed beyond Chi You, so they are limited to this area and unable to invade and harm other regions. Let us return to the Cultivator Alliance where my aunt can discuss more details with you. She is the Elder of the Cultivator Alliance.
9000021.ch: 所幸冥气未扩散出赤幽州，他们也因此被困于此州，无法侵害其它区域，待我们回仙盟，姑姑自会和你细说，我姑姑可是仙盟长老哦。

9000022.en: You make haste and follow Yuan'er to the Cultivator Alliance. From far away, you see a huge city built on a mountain. It looks grand on the outside, and when you enter, you find that it is like a palace built on the air, with pavilions reaching up into the clouds. High towers have been built around the perimeter, where Cultivators stand guard.
9000022.ch: 一路奔波，你随顾鸢儿终于来到了仙盟，远远的便看到一座巨城盘山而建，显得十分宏伟，进到城中，更是宫阁浮空，亭廊卧云，周边另建高塔岗哨，上设修仙者把守观望。

9000023.en: My friend, this is our base! You can rest here safe and sound! Is it impressive? It's heavily guarded, and even that Xingtian near the Ancient Gate can't breach our defense!
9000023.ch: 道友，此处便是我仙盟根本重地，道友可以在此安心歇息。看起来很厉害吧？这里固若金汤，即使是太古玄门旁边的刑天也不易攻破！

9000024.en: That's our wall to repel the Wave of Monsters. Isn't it impressive? The first generation of cultivators who came to Chi You built it on the mountains to protect themselves from monster invasions.
9000024.ch: 那是我仙盟抵御兽潮的城墙，很厉害吧？第一批进入赤幽州修仙者被兽潮侵扰，前辈们便依着山势构筑城垣抵挡兽潮。

9000025.en: See? We Cultivator Alliance is the last line of defense for all the cultivators. There is still hope for this world only because we are holding off the overwhelming Wave of Monsters here.
9000025.ch: 哼哼，我们仙盟就是修仙者的最后防线，我们在这抵御汹涌的兽潮，可说是这八荒世界的最后希望。

9000026.en: The monsters in Chi You are affected by the Nether Air here, and they are corrupted at intervals and rally to attack the Alliance. That's what we call the Wave of Monsters. I really hope I can go beyond the wall to fight them like the other guards.
9000026.ch: 赤幽州的冥气影响妖兽，这些妖兽在特定时候会被冥气侵蚀，然后一起对仙盟发起冲击，我们叫这做兽潮。唉，真想像其他仙卫一样离开城墙对付妖兽啊。

9000027.en: Many years ago, the Nether Mountains blocked the Wayward Desert connecting Chi You to Mu Xian. Since then, we have been guarding here, protecting all the districts behind us!
9000027.ch: 许多年前冥山封闭了连接赤幽州和暮仙州的迷途荒漠，自打那以后我们就一直守在这里。就是我们一直在保护着后面各州的安全啊！

9000028.en: There is an Ancient Gate close to Tian Yuan Mountain in the depths of Chi You, where the Demonic god Xingtian sits. The Nether Air all around in Chi You all leak from underground, and is the work of Xingtian.
9000028.ch: 赤幽州深处靠近天元山附近有一扇太古玄门，里面有魔神刑天坐镇。赤幽州中冥气四处都是从地底泄出的冥气，便是刑天干的好事。

9000029.en: Once this Demonic god waves his axe, great changes occur in Chi You. Nether Air would surge and gather everywhere, making the monsters more ferocious than ever. With Jiuying in command, they would pose an even greater threat. And don't forget Taowu, another ferocious beast not far away from here.
9000029.ch: 这尊魔神一旦舞动手上斧头，赤幽州就会迎来剧变；那时四处都会聚起冥气，妖兽都会变得十分凶狠。再加上九婴指挥，就更是不得了了。对了，近郊还有一只梼杌凶兽。

9000030.en: We used to have supplies from the other sects before, but since the Nether Mountains blocked our path to Mu Xian, the Alliance has been isolated from the outside world, and it's very difficult for us to hold out all by ourselves. Now? We plan to fortify the wall to better resist the Wave of Monsters. And I also want to reclaim the Heaven Sacrifice Altar beyond the wall...
9000030.ch: 原本仙盟还有八荒各州宗门作为后继补给，但是很多年前冥山隔绝了暮仙州，仙盟因此断绝了与外界的联系，我们的局面也变得异常艰难。眼前么？我们打算进一步巩固仙盟的城墙，好抵挡兽潮呢。我呢，想要收回城墙外面的祈天台来……

9000031.en: You're finally back! {name|A}, this is the Cultivator Alliance base! Awesome, eh?
9000031.ch: 终于回来了！{name|A}，这便是仙盟所在地啦，怎么样，还不错吧！

9000032.en: Red flows from the pavilions in the sky, rising through the sky. There is an ambience indeed.
9000032.ch: 飞阁流丹，耸入云霄，确有一番气象。

9000033.en: Before your conversation, an older female Cultivator descended and landed in front of you. Her cultivation was so profound that you could not comprehend it.
9000033.ch: 就在你们说话之时，一位年长女修士御空而下，落在你们跟前，修为高深，你竟然无法看透。

9000035.en: As soon as the words are uttered, Gu Yuan'er bounces between you and Luo Ying with her hands behind her back, and her head tilted up.
9000035.ch: 话音刚落，顾鸢儿便蹦到了你和骆瑛之间，背负双手，微微抬起了头。

9000036.en: It's because I told my aunt in advance, of course!
9000036.ch: 那当然是我提前告诉姑姑的啦！

9000037.en: Yuan'er travels often between the Wayward Desert and Chi You, and she informed me right away when she met you.
9000037.ch: 鸢儿经常在迷途荒漠和赤幽州之间历练，遇到小友之时，便第一时间传音告知了我。

9000038.en: That's right. I see that your cultivation is excellent despite your age. Perhaps the task of defeating the Demonic god Xingtian and entering Tian Yuan Mountain is not an impossible one for you...
9000038.ch: 不错，老身看小友年纪不是很大，修为就已如此精湛，也许打败魔神刑天，进入天元山，对你并非不可能之事，奈何……

9000039.en: Luo Ying raises her hand and points south. You look in the direction she points and sees the vague outline of continuous city walls on a mountain range, coiling like a dragon.
9000039.ch: 骆瑛举起手，指向南方，你循着手指的方向望去，隐隐约约看到有一道连绵不断的城垣横亘在群山之上，宛若巨龙。

9000040.en: Nether Air swirls all around, and waves of monsters can appear at any time beyond those walls. If you go there right now, I'm afraid you would die of exhaustion from dealing with the never-ending flow of monsters before you get to the Demonic god Xingtian.
9000040.ch: 如今冥气四溢，在那城垣之外，兽潮随时会至，你若在此时前去，只怕未走到魔神刑天面前，便因为应付源源不断的妖兽力竭而死。

9000041.en: Why not remain in the Cultivator Alliance and wait for the wave of monsters to pass before you decide to move on?
9000041.ch: 不若先留在仙盟，待兽潮过去，再行他定。

9000042.en: Senior Luo Ying's words seem to ring true. It would be wise to wait and observe a bit more.
9000042.ch: 看骆瑛前辈的话，不似作伪，不妨先再观望一番。

9000043.en: In that case, please excuse my intrusion, Senior.
9000043.ch: 既然如此，我便在此打扰前辈了。

9000044.en: It is no trouble. One more person means one more fighter. Oh yes, as a traveler from another region, do you know Feng Yunchuo?
9000044.ch: 无妨，多一个人，也多一分力。对了，你既从其他州过来，可知风允婼？

9000045.en: Good. Chief Feng is leading men to exterminate the monsters that have sneaked in. Yuan'er, take our friend to Chief Feng.
9000045.ch: 那正好，风族长正在带人消灭偷跑进来的妖兽，鸢儿，你带这位小友前去寻找风族长。

9000046.en: Okay. Come on, {name|A}. I'll take you to Chief Feng.
9000046.ch: 好嘞，{name|A}，走吧，我带你去找风族长。

9000047.en: I sent you to scout out the monsters behind us. Are you done already? Why are you back?
9000047.ch: 小妮子，我让巡查后方妖兽情形，你干完了么？这就回来了？

9000048.en: Oh! Aunt Luo! This is a Cultivator from Mu Xian. He is very skilled! He eliminated the monsters behind us!
9000048.ch: 啊！骆姑姑！这位是从暮仙州过来的修仙者，他十分了得，将后方的妖兽消灭了！

9000049.en: I'm Luo Ying, an Elder of the Cultivator Alliance. You are a guest from Mu Xian, but I'm afraid our Alliance doesn't have the means to receive you properly.
9000049.ch: 老身骆瑛，乃仙盟长老之一。阁下从暮仙州而来，原是贵客，只可惜仙盟之中别无长物，只好怠慢了。

9000050.en: Gu Yuan'er, take this guest of ours on a walk around here before sending this guest back to Mu Xian.
9000050.ch: 顾鸢儿，你带贵客周围走走。若无要事就将贵客送回暮仙州去。

9000051.en: Elder Luo Ying has turned on her heels before finishing her words. She didn't lay her eyes on you even once.
9000051.ch: 这名叫骆瑛的仙盟长老说完就转身去了，由始至终她竟未曾注视过你。

9000052.en: Well, would you like to have a rest in the town first? I'm patrolling behind the Alliance territory most of the time. You will find me when you leave the town. I'll take you on a walk then!
9000052.ch: 这个，你先在城中歇息一下吧？我多在后方巡查，你离开仙盟城池就能看见我。到时我带你周围逛逛吧！

9000053.en: The Alliance territory is heavily guarded. You can rest here safely.
9000053.ch: 仙盟根本之地固若金汤，道友在这里可以安心歇息。

9000054.en: Well... Nether Demons... They seem to be, no. They have always been the enemies of the Alliance. Sometimes they take the form of humans, but they are in fact all Mythical Beasts.
9000054.ch: 呃……冥妖……好像，啊不。这冥妖就是一直以来就和我们仙盟作对。它们有时候化成人样跟我们长得差不多，其实都是大妖兽。

9000055.en: The intelligence of ordinary monsters is low, so they won't pose much threat. But these Nether Demons are completely different! They are almost as powerful as Transcendent cultivators, and they can sometimes cast our Martial Arts! Most importantly, they can serve as commanders in the Wave of Monsters!
9000055.ch: 一般妖兽智能低下，难成气候。但这些冥妖就不一样啦！他们实力强悍，堪比登仙大能，有时还能使出我们的功法！而且关键是它们还会成为兽潮的指挥者！

9000056.en: Let me think. That Jiuying who is in command of the Wave of Monsters to charge at our defense is such a Nether Demon.
9000056.ch: 我想想啊，现在指挥兽潮冲击防线的九婴，就是这类冥妖。

9000057.en: My friend, you must come here for that girl. Unfortunately, I just saw Elder Luo occupied by urgent matters, and she brought Yuan'er out of the Alliance.
9000057.ch: 道友想必是来此地寻那鸢儿丫头的吧，还真是不巧，刚刚我见骆长老有些急事，唤鸢儿丫头跟着一起出去了。

9000058.en: Some rumors said that these days there are many Cultivators from every corner of the world coming to join us, in order to resist the wave of monsters together. If it's true, our power will certainly increase, and the Alliance may even eradicate the Nether Demons and defeat Xingtian!
9000058.ch: 据说近日，八荒各州来了许多修仙者意欲加入仙盟、共同抵御兽潮，如此一来，我仙盟战力提升，或许扫荡冥妖、力克刑天也并非不可能！

9000059.en: Elder Luo should feel happy rather than depressed when receiving visitors here every day. Maybe the one she expecting is not here yet...
9000059.ch: 骆长老整日接待宾客，理应喜悦，但我却观其心情沉郁，似乎其料想之人并未出现……

9000060.en: In the past, when the ways to the Nether Mountains were blocked, Elder Luo usually told others matters of Demon in Yun Mo. Though I know little about them, it is said that those demons play a critical role in the Alliance's resistance to the Nether Air. However, Elder Luo has always been occupied by various works, and cannot arrange a visit there...
9000060.ch: 昔日冥山封闭之时，我时常听闻骆长老谈及云陌州魔族之事，我虽不甚了解此族，但据说此族对仙盟对抗冥气有着至关重要的作用，只恨骆长老事务繁忙，无暇抽身去请……

9000061.en: Now, if we could assist the Demon in the critical moment, they must come here to assist us someday. I'll go back then...
9000061.ch: 如今帮助魔族渡过难关，想必他们不日便会前往仙盟助阵，我当先行返回……

9000062.en: You're here? I was just going to kill some more monsters over there, but I want to show you something. Follow me!
9000062.ch: 你来啦？原本还想再到后方清除一下妖物，呃，不过我想起一个好去处，你先跟我来！

9000063.en: Actually you're not our only visitor from Mu Xian. After what happened to the Nether Mountains back then, Aunt Luo received a powerful cultivator from Yun Mo. You can talk with him yourself!
9000063.ch: 哼哼，你知道嘛？其实不只你从暮仙州来到仙盟。之前冥山发生大动静后，骆姑姑就亲自迎接了一位高人，据说他来自云陌州，到时你们可要好好聊聊！

9000064.en: You see a dozen Demon men and women healing wounded Alliance disciples, and some of them are using a special spell to remove the Nether Air in them. They are all glad to see you.
9000064.ch: 眼前地方有十数名魔族男女正在为仙盟之人治疗包扎，有些则用奇特的法子祛除冥气。他们发现了你后，一个个都投来欢喜的眼神。

9000065.en: Hero, it's such a pleasure! You come to Chi You too?
9000065.ch: 恩人！你也来到赤幽州了？

9000066.en: Thank you for saving us back then! Chief Feng is always talking about you!
9000066.ch: 恩人！风族长常常提起你呢！

9000068.en: This person is a great savior of the demon tribe!
9000068.ch: 这位是于我们魔族有大恩惠的恩人！

9000069.en: Oh! So you must know Chief Feng too? Huh? Where is Chief Feng now?
9000069.ch: 啊？那你也认识风族长？哎？风族长怎么没在？

9000070.en: Chief Feng felt some remaining Nether Air behind the Alliance and presumed it must be from a powerful monster. He left to hunt it with several Alliance Guards!
9000070.ch: 族长发现仙盟后方有冥气残余。依他推断，当是后方有强大妖兽进入到仙盟范围之中。族长与几名仙卫一同前去击杀妖兽了！

9000071.en: Oh! Let's go and give him a hand!
9000071.ch: 哦！那我们快去找风族长！

9000072.en: You hear the noises of a fierce battle ahead. Several Alliance disciples and Feng Yunchuo are attacking a monster together, but it breaks away and escapes. The Alliance disciples turn to Feng Yunchuo angrily.
9000072.ch: 前方传来激战之声，几名仙盟弟子及风允婼正在围攻一只妖兽，不过妖兽突然突破他们的围攻脱身而去。几名仙盟弟子随即对风允婼怒目瞪视。

9000073.en: Chief Feng, why don't you go to the Ancient Gate and kill Xingtian if you think you are so good? Please go back and don't interfere in our business again.
9000073.ch: 风族长既然如此了得，应该直接去到太古玄门击杀刑天才是。这事就不要掺和了，请回吧。

9000074.en: It's the duty of us Alliance Guards to handle Alliance affairs. Since you were asked by Elder Luo to remove the Nether Air in wounded Alliance disciples, you should focus on your task.
9000074.ch: 仙盟之事自有我等仙卫处置，风族长既受骆长老请托在仙盟为受伤弟子祛除冥气，风族长就应该好好为他们医治才是。

9000075.en: That monster was affected by Nether Air. They were much more dangerous than ordinary ones. I followed you in case some of you would get wounded.
9000075.ch: 妖兽受冥气侵染，绝非寻常。我恐怕兄弟们稍有疏忽，便要受伤。

9000076.en: Chief Feng came only to help you. Why were you so mean to him?
9000076.ch: 风族长出于一片好心才帮助你们，你们就不要阴阳怪气了吧？

9000077.en: Those Alliance disciples give Feng Yunchuo a cold glance and take their leave with a sneer.
9000077.ch: 几名仙盟弟子对风允婼投来冷眼，哼了一声就都走了。

9000078.en: Oh! It's you, hero! And Miss Gu! That monster is not to be trifled with. They will run into trouble if they engage the monster recklessly. I must go after them. Excuse me.
9000078.ch: 啊！是恩人，顾小姐也在。妖兽不易对付，他们贸然接战，会出意外的。我跟去看看，恕罪。

9000079.en: We should go after them too! Come on!

9000080.en: Feng Yunchuo has gone far away chasing the monster. Gu Yuan'er is very eager and wants to catch up with him to help kill the monster.
9000080.ch: 风允婼追截妖兽已经去得很远了，你身边的顾鸢儿亦跃跃欲试，希望追上帮助风允婼击杀妖兽。

9000081.en: You follow Gu Yuan'er and find Feng Yunchuo leading his men in battle against a large group of monsters.
9000081.ch: 你跟随着顾鸢儿，找到了风允婼，发现其正带着族人在和一大群妖兽作战。

9000082.en: {name|A}, Chief Feng won't be able to finish off all of these monsters so quickly. I'll go lend him a hand!
9000082.ch: {name|A}，风族长似乎一时半会解决不掉这些妖兽，我先去帮他了！

9000083.en: Ah, it's {name|A}. I did not expect us to meet again here after we parted ways.
9000083.ch: 竟是{name|A}小友，没想到当年一别，你我二人会在此地相聚。

9000084.en: Are you headed to Tian Yuan Mountain, my friend?
9000084.ch: 小友此行可是要前往天元山？

9000085.en: You know that my tribe has been burdened by Nether Air, and I've been looking for a solution.
9000085.ch: 你也知，我族身受冥气侵扰，我一直在需求解决之法。

9000086.en: A few years ago, I found an ancient book about the world in a Mystic Realm, and discovered that the world situation is more complicated than I'd thought.
9000086.ch: 前些年我在一处秘境中，找到一本八荒古籍，才发现这八荒的局势竟比我想象之中更为复杂几分。

9000087.en: The ancient book holds speculation that the Nether Air in the world come from Tian Yuan Mountain. If we want to solve this problem we have with Nether Air, we must enter Tian Yuan Mountain, but...
9000087.ch: 古籍之中猜测，八荒的冥气源自天元山，若想解决冥气之祸，势必要进入到天元山之中，可是……

9000088.en: If you want to enter Tian Yuan Mountain, the only entrance is the Ancient Gate deep in Chi You. However, this gate is being guarded by the Demonic god Xingtian and cannot be passed.
9000088.ch: 若想进入天元山，唯一的入口便是赤幽州深处的太古玄门，但此门，如今正被魔神刑天镇守，无法通过。

9000089.en: I don't know. It has existed a very long time ago, and rumors say that Xingtian wields an axe and a shield, and large amounts of Nether Air gushes out of Chi You whenever he swings his axe, corrupting everything.
9000089.ch: 不知，很久很久之前就存在了，传闻这刑天有一斧一盾，每当他挥动手上之斧时候，赤幽州就会溢出大量冥气，侵蚀万物。

9000090.en: The ancient book mentioned that Goumang, the Deity of Wood, descended into the world and battled Xingtian several times. Now, Xingtian remains in one piece, but Goumang is nowhere to be found...
9000090.ch: 古籍中曾提到，木神句芒曾分出一缕神识，降临八荒，和刑天大战数场，如今刑天安在，但句芒却不知所踪……

9000091.en: Goumang is a deity from a higher realm who possesses unfathomable strength. He can create a world at a thought, but even a deity is not an obstacle to Xingtian. I'm afraid it will not be easy to accomplish what I'd like to do.
9000091.ch: 句芒是上界仙人，实力深不可测，一念之间便可创造一个世界，可连神祇的一缕意识都奈何不得刑天，风某恐怕也难以做到所想之事了。

9000092.en: While you and Chief Feng are talking, Gu Yuan'er received Luo Ying's message and walks towards the two of you.
9000092.ch: 就在你和风族长交谈之际，顾鸢儿收到了骆瑛的传音，向你们走来。

9000093.en: Chief Feng, {name|A}, my aunt requests that you hurry back. There is a matter of importance to discuss.
9000093.ch: 风族长，{name|A}，姑姑邀请你们速速回去，有事相商哦。

9000094.en: We've been out for quite a while. It's time to rest our legs, {name|A}! Let's head back together!
9000094.ch: 出来这么久了，也该回去休息休息，{name|A}小友，我们一同回去吧！

9000095.en: Chief Feng, {name|A}, I come with great haste to report changes in the battle ahead.
9000095.ch: 风族长，{name|A}小友，急忙寻找二位，实是因为前方战事有变。

9000097.en: Many disciples of the Cultivator Alliance on the frontline have delivered the news that the monster wave may arrive ahead of time, as they have encountered many monsters already.
9000097.ch: 我们诸多仙盟弟子在前线传来消息，兽潮似有提前的迹象，他们遭遇了不少妖兽，情况十分危险。

9000098.en: I will go to their rescue right away.

9000100.en: Since multiple places need our help, would Chief Feng go to one place, and you and Yuan'er go to another?
9000100.ch: 由于有多处地方求援，麻烦风族长前往一处，鸢儿和小友一道前往另一处地方吧。

9000102.en: No problem. I've got some ass to kick.
9000102.ch: 没问题，看本姑娘把这些妖兽打得落花流水！

9000104.en: Thank you, {name|A}, for willing to help, even though you have just arrived at the Cultivator Alliance. Here are some {itemLink1011724} for you.
9000104.ch: {name|A}小友未到仙盟多久，便愿意帮忙，老身感激不尽，这里有几颗{itemLink1011724}，你拿去以备不时之需吧。

9000105.en: No time to delay. Let's go.

9000106.en: You arrive at the destination, just to find that several members of the Cultivator Alliance are about to lose to a group of monsters.
9000106.ch: 你们刚来到此处，便发现几个仙盟成员正在和一群妖兽厮杀，败相已现。

9000107.en: We are just in time. Or it would be too late.
9000107.ch: 还好我们及时赶到，再晚一点恐怕就来不及了。

9000108.en: At that moment, Gu Yuan'er dashes towards the herd, when a monster suddenly jumps up from behind. At this juncture, you intercept the monster.
9000108.ch: 话音刚落，顾鸢儿便向兽群中赶去，突然一只妖兽在从地下窜出，直扑其身后，千钧一发之际，你急忙出手拦住此妖。

9000109.en: Thank god, you are here. Otherwise, I would have gotten myself killed.
9000109.ch: 幸好你在，否则我非但没救成他们，自己反而要出事了……

9000110.en: Never mind! Let's go help them out!
9000110.ch: 嗯！走吧，我们赶紧过去帮他们吧。

9000111.en: As you and Gu Yuan'er join the fight, the monsters are soon eliminated and the disciples of the Cultivator Alliance are saved.
9000111.ch: 随着你和顾鸢儿加入战斗， 妖兽很快就被消灭，仙盟弟子们也得救了。

9000112.en: Yuan'er, you are just in time!
9000112.ch: 鸢儿，你来得及太及时了！

9000113.en: Sure. It's just a piece of cake for me.
9000113.ch: 那是，本姑娘出手，那不是手到擒来！

9000115.en: My name is {name|A}. Nice to meet you guys.

9000116.en: I brought him back. Heehee! {name|A} is a skillful guy, who has just arrived at the Cultivator Alliance. Don't you bully {gender2|A}!
9000116.ch: 是我捡回来的哦，嘿嘿！{name|A}刚到我们仙盟，实力很强的，你们可不准欺负{gender|A}。

9000117.en: We will not. {name|A} saved us. Why would we bully {gender2|A}?
9000117.ch: 这话说的，{name|A}对我等有救命之恩，怎会欺负{gender|A}。

9000118.en: That's right. {name|A} doesn't seem to be very old, yet has reached {grade|A}. {gender|A} may become one of the pillars of the Cultivator Alliance one day.
9000118.ch: 不错，观{name|A}道友年龄并不大，修为就已达{grade|A}，说不定以后便是我们仙盟的中流砥柱了。

9000119.en: Hey! That's out of line. Do you take me as nothing?
9000119.ch: 喂喂喂！你们这马屁吹过头了吧，本姑娘还在这里呢！

9000120.en: Of course not. You are the most powerful in the Cultivator Alliance.
9000120.ch: 当然，我们的鸢儿才是仙盟最强战力！

9000122.en: Time to go back, or the Elder will be worried.
9000122.ch: 那我们赶紧回去吧，免得长老担心。

9000123.en: Aunt, we are back, safe and sound!

9000124.en: If not for Yuan'er and {name|A}, we might not be able to come back.
9000124.ch: 长老，此番幸好有鸢儿和{name|A}道友，否则我们回不来了。

9000125.en: Yes. {name|A} is amazingly good at such a young age. The sky is the limit.
9000125.ch: 不错不错，{name|A}小友如此年纪修为竟如此厉害，未来不可限量。

9000127.ch: 小友谦虚了，只怕我可能还低估了你。

9000128.en: Elder, why don't we invite {name|A} to join the Cultivator Alliance?
9000128.ch: 长老，不如邀请{name|A}道友加入我们仙盟吧。

9000129.en: Good idea! If {name|A} joins us, we will be able to slash monsters together, won't we?
9000129.ch: 这提议好！若{name|A}加入，岂不是可以经常随我一起去斩杀妖兽了！

9000130.en: My friend, I also hope you can join the Cultivator Alliance because it has sufficient resources to help you grow. When the monster wave recedes, it can also help you go to Tian Yuan Mountain.
9000130.ch: 小友，老身也希望你加入仙盟，毕竟仙盟资源充足，有助你修炼，待那兽潮退去，也能为你前往天元山提供一臂之力。

9000131.en: {name|A}, it's an honor for our alliance to have you. On behalf of the alliance, I'd like to present this {0} to you.
9000131.ch: {name|A}小友加入仙盟，实在是我盟之幸事，这{0}老身便代表仙盟送给小友。

9000132.en: There is something I need you to do for me.
9000132.ch: 这有件事，可能要麻烦小友前去一探。

9000133.en: There is a high platform outside the city wall, called the Heaven Sacrifice Altar. It was built by the Cultivator Alliance to pray for the arrival of the three-legged immortal crow to dispel the nether air.
9000133.ch: 那城墙之外有一高台，名为祈天台，本为我仙盟建造用来祈求三足仙乌降临祛除冥气之用。

9000134.en: Unfortunately, it failed to summon the immortal crow, but because of the special materials used in its construction, as well as the powerful barriers built on its periphery, the Heaven Sacrifice Altar gradually became an important place for the Cultivator Alliance to place books, martial arts, and treasures.
9000134.ch: 可惜建造后未能成功召唤到仙乌，倒是因为其建造材料的特殊，以及搭建在其外围的阵法结界之强大，祈天台渐渐变成了我仙盟放置书籍、功法和宝物的重要地方。

9000135.en: Alas. A few decades ago, we were caught off guard by a monster wave. As a result, the defense line of the Cultivator Alliance had to shrink to what we have today, and the Heaven Sacrifice Altar became an enclave.
9000135.ch: 哎，数十年前的一场兽潮来袭，我们准备未足，被冥妖大败，仙盟防线不得不收缩到如今区域，导致祈天台长久孤悬在外。

9000136.en: Although the Heaven Sacrifice Altar has been in the hinterland of the nether demons, it remains intact because of the powerful barrier surrounding it. According to the records of the Cultivator Alliance, the energy supporting the barrier of the Altar will soon be depleted. If it falls to the hands of the nether demons by then, the consequences are unimaginable.
9000136.ch: 那祈天台这些年虽深处冥妖腹地，但因有着强大的结界，始终安好无损。可根据仙盟记载，祈天台内支撑法阵的能量即将消耗殆尽，若到时候祈天台陷于冥妖之手，后果不堪设想。

9000137.en: So here I would like to request you, my friend, to go ahead and destroy the Heaven Sacrifice Altar.
9000137.ch: 老身，老身在此请求小友前去销毁祈天台。

9000138.en: The Cultivator Alliance has grown too fast over the years by recruiting members of unknown origins. I am afraid that the news may reach the ears of the nether demons if I ask another member to do the job.
9000138.ch: 仙盟这些年发展太快，人员参差不齐，我担心若让其他人做此事，会泄露消息给到冥妖，到时候冥妖的首领九婴若知，只怕有去无回。

9000139.en: As you are new to this place, and you are a courageous and careful person, I believe you are the best option.
9000139.ch: 而小友初到此地，行事又胆大心细，你来做此事，老身放心。

9000140.en: I've taken that into consideration. Come here, Yuan'er.
9000140.ch: 这老身已考虑到了。鸢儿，过来。

9000141.en: Just as Luo Ying speaks, Gu Yuan'er comes out from nowhere, with her mouth filled up with something. Seeing you are here as well, she swallows it and gives a gentle burp.
9000141.ch: 只见骆瑛话音刚落，顾鸢儿不知从哪个地方冒了出来，嘴巴鼓鼓的，看到你也在一旁，赶忙吞下食物，轻轻打了一个嗝。

9000144.en: Aaahh! My lady image is spoiled!
9000144.ch: 啊啊啊啊，我的淑女形象没了！！！

9000145.en: All right, Yuan'er. Stop messing around. I have a job for you here.
9000145.ch: 好了，鸢儿别闹了，我叫你来有正事。

9000146.en: What is it, Aunt? I'll not let you down.
9000146.ch: 姑姑，有什么事尽管说，鸢儿保证给你干得漂漂亮亮的！

9000147.en: Would you take {name|A} to the Heaven Sacrifice Altar to destroy it?
9000147.ch: 你带{name|A}小友前往祈天台，助小友将其销毁。

9000148.en: Aunt, do you mean we can get out through the hidden portal?
9000148.ch: 姑姑，你是说通过那个隐藏的传送阵出去吗？

9000149.en: Yuan'er's father Gu Nangang used to be an expert on arrays in the Cultivator Alliance. He once secretly built a portal in case of emergency. After his death, only Yuan'er and I know the location of the portal and how to activate it.
9000149.ch: 鸢儿她爹顾南罡当年是仙盟的阵法大家，曾经秘密搭建了一座传送阵，以备不时之需，他爹死后，此阵只有我和鸢儿知道位置和开启方法。

9000150.en: No worries. I'll take care of the array.
9000150.ch: 放心吧，有我在，阵法的事情都不是问题！

9000151.en: Yes. Yuan'er may be young, but she is more talented than her father in terms of arrays. By far, she has had almost 80% of her father's capability.
9000151.ch: 不错，你别看鸢儿年纪小，在阵法一道的天赋比他爹当年都强，如今已有南罡当时的七八分实力。

9000152.en: Humph. You didn't expect me to be such an expert, did you? Without further ado, let's go now!
9000152.ch: 哼哼，想不到吧，我厉害的可多着呢，事不宜迟，我们出发吧！

9000153.en: Hang on! One more thing: although the monsters can't access the Altar, Jiuying has been guarding against the humans by assigning Taowu, one of the four fierce monsters of Chi You, in the vicinity.
9000153.ch: 慢着，我还有一事要告知你们，虽说妖兽无法奈何祈天台，但九婴一直防范着人族靠近，安排了赤幽州四凶之一的梼杌在周围看守。

9000154.en: The monster is a powerful one. Although it may be absent once in a while, you still need to be more careful. If anything, just send me a telepathic voice and I will come to your rescue.
9000154.ch: 那梼杌实力强悍，虽说如今经常消失一段时间，但你们仍需多加小心，若有意外，鸢儿你及时传音于我，我自会来救你们。

9000155.en: No worries, Aunt! With {name|A}, we are confident to get the job done.
9000155.ch: 放心吧，姑姑！有{name|A}在，我们一定圆满完成任务。

9000158.en: So have you joined a sect already?
9000158.ch: 看小友可是已有宗门之人？

9000159.en: The Cultivator Alliance is looking to build another sect. As far as I see, your sect is growing vigorously and has great potential. How about relocating your sect to Chi You?
9000159.ch: 仙盟近日正欲再建一座宗门，老身观小友的宗门发展蓬勃，潜力巨大，不若将总舵迁来赤幽州如何？

9000160.en: Yes. If you do so, your sect will be able to recruit reborn and transcendent cultivators to make your sect even stronger.
9000160.ch: 不错，若搬迁到赤幽州，阁下的宗门便可将赤幽州诸多羽化和登仙修士招入门内，可以极大加强宗门的实力。

9000161.en: Besides, the Cultivator Alliance will do everything to support your sect!
9000161.ch: 仙盟也会全力扶持小友宗门！

9000162.en: Sure. Xi Zhao, would you help my friend with the relocation of the sect?
9000162.ch: 这是自然。奚照，你来协助小友统筹宗门搬迁之事。

9000163.en: Yes! {name|A}, please allow me to help you with the relocation of your sect.
9000163.ch: 遵令。{name|A}道友，便由我来协助你进行宗门搬迁。
